StringColumn.Name: Port
StringColumn.Caption: Port
StringColumn.FullDescription: The port to which these settings apply.

StringColumn.Name: Version
StringColumn.Caption: Version
StringColumn.FullDescription: The IFCSUM version to use when sending messages to this port. It is recommended that you use V2.0 whenever possible, however there are some ports that require older versions.

StringColumn.Name: ProductionEmail
StringColumn.Caption: Production Email
StringColumn.FullDescription: Messages for this port will be sent to this email address.

StringColumn.Name: ProductionID
StringColumn.Caption: Production Recipient ID
StringColumn.FullDescription: The "Recipient ID" to use when sending messages to this port.

StringColumn.Name: TestingEmail
StringColumn.Caption: Testing Email
StringColumn.FullDescription: Test messages for this port will be sent to this email address.

StringColumn.Name: TestingID
StringColumn.Caption: Testing Recipient ID
StringColumn.FullDescription: The "Recipient ID" to use when sending test messages to this port.
